race.comment: HORIZONS (10) deep into the preparation and backs-up quickly after sitting on the speed when no match for Satono Jasmine, finishing second over 1800m at Randwick last Saturday. Will hold a forward position from the good gate and expected to get the 2000m. CHEVAL DE BOIS (9) struck trouble at the start and got further back than anticipated before closing hard with a gritty second over 1500m here in weaker company. Racing like he's looking for this journey now and a win looks imminent. EXISTENTIAL BOB (7) win record hardly excites but he gets map favours today on the improving surface. Taken back from the outside gate and circled the field with a respectable third over 1800m at Randwick in the heavy (9) going. Top-three contender. MO CHROI (3) scored a dominant win at his Australian debut, then jumped in grade from the wide gate with a fading fourteenth over 2000m at this track. Kept fresh and can make sharp improvement from the inside gate. ANYTHINK GOES (1) stays in the mix.
